safety.detail: No direct application-linked recall record found in the checked FDA snapshot. This does not establish absence of recalls or safety.
limits: Recall API coverage begins in 2002; earlier recalls are not exhaustively covered. Malformed direct identifiers are excluded from accepted joins and shown separately for review.
Only root pma_numbers/k_numbers used for joins; recognized PMA supplements normalize to their parent application. Harmonized manufacturer identifiers and name similarity are excluded.
FDA notice index pages for 2023–2026 screened by explicit product/class terms; pre-2023 web archives and manufacturer notices not exhaustively reviewed.

Source-field audits and notice-scope decisions are distinct from clinical signoff or patient/unit matching. FDA recall status is as reported in the dated snapshot. MAUDE and enforcement reconciliation are outside this review.

labelReview.scope: VIATORR TIPS family; current controlled-expansion MRI page distinguished from original graft

findings.text: The controlled-expansion device is MR Conditional, with specified field strength, SAR and scan-duration limits; an implant artifact can obscure its lumen.
The manufacturer directs users to the exact market-specific eIFU for the complete warnings and restrictions; a generic statement of MRI safety is insufficient.
